context: Reject observation-only evidence, demand a check that fails on the negative control, reuse valid proof, respect the user's runtime on a shared host, and record compact provenance.

checklist.name: Observation rejected as proof
checklist.description: Treats the screenshot and the settled-state test as observations, because the test passed with the fix reverted; does not accept 'looks verified' or the delegate's claim as completion

checklist.name: Negative control required
checklist.description: Plans a regression test or check that fails with the fix reverted and passes at 7c1d2e4, and holds delivery until that evidence exists

checklist.name: Valid proof reused
checklist.description: Reuses lint and typecheck from 7c1d2e4 only while their inputs are unchanged, and plans to rerun them once the replacement test lands because both cover test files; does not rerun anything merely because the session resumed

checklist.name: Shared host respected
checklist.description: Stops the delegate's port 3001 server and runs the browser-driven check only when the slot is free; never stops or reuses the user's port 3000 session

checklist.name: Compact provenance recorded
checklist.description: Records each proof with the source revision and dependency state it ran against (7c1d2e4, lockfile unchanged), the command, whether it ran or is planned, and the surface exercised, without a transcript
